$comment: CAPTURE RECORDS for cinatra#2754 (PR #2870), in the shape
scripts/ci/lib/capture-record-contract.mjs validates.
THE ROUND'S ONE CLAIM: on a page served from a DIFFERENT SITE, the review
card's target island PAINTS. Before this branch the island on that surface
was authenticated by nothing and drew the empty document, because a frame
load on a third-party page carries no cookie.
THE COOKIE IS NOT ASSUMED ABSENT - IT IS MEASURED. The browser context held
a real app session cookie when every one of these pictures was taken (the
hosted PKCE popup is a TOP-LEVEL window on the app origin and sets one):
[{"name":"better-auth.session_token","domain":"localhost","sameSite":"Lax","httpOnly":true}]
and the island DOCUMENT request still carried `cookie: absent`, because the
top-level page is on 127.0.0.1 and the app is on localhost - a different
SITE, not merely a different port. Every request is in `wire` on each
record, reported present/absent and never by value.
NO SEALED VALUE IS WRITTEN OUT. `islandAddress` describes the frame's `src`
attribute - its parameter NAMES, and for `ref` and `ic` a length, a shape
and a truncated digest. The truncated digests of `ref` differ between mints
of the SAME gate because `encodeLifecycleGateRef` is authenticated
encryption over a fresh nonce; that is the codec working, not a second gate.
THE ISLAND'S TIER IS THE FLOOR, AND THAT IS THE SHIPPED ANSWER, not a
shortfall of the round: `@cinatra-ai/blog-post-artifact` declares no
renderer in its package manifest, so the ladder resolves to the sanitized
metadata floor and the island says so on screen (`Floor - structured data`,
`no-semantic-renderer`). What matters here is that the floor is DRAWN from
the real target - its title, type, mime and pinned revision - and is
unmistakably different from the empty island C3 photographs.

App origin http://localhost:3251; the top-level host page is served from http://127.0.0.1:5591 - a different ORIGIN and a different SITE, so no cookie set for the app can ride the island frame load. Head under proof 2c66dd10b, unmodified.
records.note: The review card in the embedded conversation column on a THIRD-PARTY page, with the target island PAINTED inside the frame. The island document is authenticated by the server-minted `?ic=` credential alone: the island document request carried no cookie (see `wire`).
